correctness.rationale: Every Hurwitz real planar drift with the prescribed spectrum decomposes into traceless symmetric S and skew W with S^2=c^2I, W^2=-v^2I, SW+WS=0. Spectral equality forces c^2-v^2=b^2; stationary identity covariance forces D=aI-S, positive iff b<=c<a. Exact current integration gives Phi=2a(c^2-b^2)/(a^2-c^2), and K=(a+c)/(a-c) is an increasing bijection. Orthogonal-conjugacy construction realizes every c, so the sharp cap is attained. Matrix exponential yields the finite-lag saturation. The packaged checker passes 328 independent matrix assertions and cannot replace the proof.
